name: thisdid
description: ThisDID.com — DIF Universal W3C DID Resolver.

scripts.build: npm run build:vendor && npm run build:web
scripts.dev: npm run build:web && concurrently -k -n drivers,worker,web -c cyan,blue,magenta "npm:dev:drivers" "npm:dev:worker" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:drivers: concurrently -k -n web,key,pkh,peer,ethr "wrangler dev --config src/driver-workers/web/wrangler.jsonc --port 8791 --inspector-port 9291" "wrangler dev --config src/driver-workers/key/wrangler.jsonc --port 8792 --inspector-port 9292" "wrangler dev --config src/driver-workers/pkh/wrangler.jsonc --port 8793 --inspector-port 9293" "wrangler dev --config src/driver-workers/peer/wrangler.jsonc --port 8794 --inspector-port 9294" "wrangler dev --config src/driver-workers/ethr/wrangler.jsonc --port 8795 --inspector-port 9295"
scripts.drivers:check: wrangler deploy --dry-run --config src/driver-workers/web/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config src/driver-workers/key/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config src/driver-workers/pkh/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config src/driver-workers/peer/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config src/driver-workers/ethr/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:drivers: wrangler deploy --config src/driver-workers/web/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config src/driver-workers/key/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config src/driver-workers/pkh/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config src/driver-workers/peer/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config src/driver-workers/ethr/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:drivers && npm run deploy:probe && npm run deploy
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:web && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build && npm run drivers:check
